name: fw Bun-Native Runtime
description: Bun-native fw plugin for OpenClaw exposing ls, grep, find, bench, claw (prefix KV + runtime TS tool compiler), and MCP JSON-RPC 2.0.

tools.name: fw_ls
tools.description: List directory entries with type and byte size using Fw Bun-native filesystem traversal.

tools.name: fw_grep
tools.description: Search file contents by literal or regex pattern with bounded match limits.

tools.name: fw_find
tools.description: Find files matching a glob pattern via Bun.Glob.

tools.name: fw_bench
tools.description: Benchmark a command or in-process snippet with Bun.nanoseconds() latency percentiles.

tools.name: fw_claw
tools.description: Dispatch Fw Hermes/OpenClaw actions (status, sandbox-check, kv-route, tool-compile).

tools.name: fw_mcp
tools.description: Execute JSON-RPC 2.0 MCP methods (initialize, tools/list, tools/call) against the Fw tool registry.

fwBinary.description: Optional path to compiled fw binary; falls back to pure Bun-native execution when absent.

cwd.description: Default working directory for ls, grep, find, and bench tools.

sandbox.description: Enforce Fw sandbox checks for runtime tools and shell binaries.
